implementation.capture: Only explicit model formatted read/ls captures exact opened bytes or typed directory manifests once; raw sandbox reads stay separate.
implementation.storage: Value-only, per-agent mutex/epoch lease; Windows physical identity and storage handles; bounded original snapshots in read-context-v1. No QObject worker callback.
implementation.history: Compact tool result metadata fileReads/pathReferences/pathMetadata; no bytes or base64 in saved session history. Per-call input hash and original params checked during preparation.
implementation.conversion: Each explicit read reinjected with its own original ranges/version, then marked seen; mentions/generated attachments dedup. Synthetic user context follows the complete tool-result block. Provider IDs and native protocol parts retained.
implementation.copy: Busy-source cloning supported without canceling or mutating source history. Fresh unowned destination only; SessionStore conflict rolls back only newly owned target.
implementation.delete: Durable session removal precedes cleanup. Host becomes terminal, cancels and revokes before deleting read/ordinary attachment context. Archive keeps context.

publicApi.cloneFileContext: bool cloneFileContext(const QString& targetAgentId, QString* error=nullptr); synchronous, busy source supported, fresh unowned target only. Clone is not a history-normalization operation.
publicApi.removeFileContext: bool removeFileContext(QString* error=nullptr); terminal host before cancellation/reset, retryable cleanup, no SessionStore/apps/workspace deletion. Failure details in error.
publicApi.creationSequence: Capture source history/settings on GUI thread, clone fresh UUID context, persist new session. On save failure roll back only that fresh target using FileReadSnapshotStore::removeAgent and AttachmentStore::removeAgent without constructing a host.
publicApi.deletionSequence: Persist session removal before invoking removeFileContext. Surface cleanup errors and keep retry record. Archive never calls removal.
publicApi.pendingTools: Parent owns copied/restored history normalization per upstream base-agent.ts845-860 before next user submission.
